detail.description: 'full' returns the whole feed for the default 14-day window even with no `since`. Omitted with no `since`, the answer is compact: exact counts for the window plus the newest rows of each lane, and the exact calls for the rest.

since.description: Return everything that changed since this ISO date. Defaults to 14 days ago. Clamped to the 90-day supported window.
